Application Steps - Getting Started
Eligibility - Review Before Starting an Application
Close Accordion
Open Accordion
To be eligible for admission for graduate study at the University of North Carolina Wilmington applicants must:
U.S. Bachelor's Degree: Students must possess a bachelor’s degree, or its U.S. equivalent, from a college or university accredited by an approved institutional accreditor.
Approved Institutional Accreditor List:
Higher Learning Commission (HLC)
Middle States Commission on Higher Education (MSCHE)
New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC)
Northwest Commission on Colleges and Universities (NWCCU)
Southern Association of Colleges and Schools, Commission on Colleges (SACS-COC)
Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC)
Case-by-Case Review: U.S. transcripts from an institution not on the approved list, whose accrediting body is recognized by the U.S. Department of Education as an Institutional Accrediting Agency (Sort list by agency type - Institutional Accreditor), may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
International Degrees: If your degree is from outside the U.S., it must be equivalent to a U.S. bachelor's degree. To verify this, an official course-by-course transcript evaluation from an agency approved by the National Association of Credential Evaluation Services (NACES) is required.
Final Transcript Verification: One official U.S. transcript or international course-by-course evaluation verifying completion of a bachelor’s degree, or equivalent, must be received prior to the first official day of classes for the admitted term.
Student Holds (Current/Previous UNCW Students): Applicants with an application hold will not be allowed to move forward in the application process until the hold is released. Check your mySeaport account to view your account hold(s) or contact studentaccounts@uncw.edu.
Grade Point Average: Have a strong overall academic record with a B average or better in the basic courses prerequisite to the area of proposed graduate study. Provisional admission may be considered by some programs. Contact the program coordinator for additional information regarding their acceptance policy.
Level: Graduate and undergraduate programs may not be pursued simultaneously.
Online Accelerated Programs (OAP): OAP programs must be pursued independent of any other program.
Additional Requirements: Meet any additional admission requirement(s) as outlined by the graduate program.

Application Fee
Close Accordion
Open Accordion
A $75 USD (non-transferable and non-refundable) application fee is due upon submission and is payable by MasterCard, Visa, or Discover via the online application.
Applicants will be prompted by the system to pay the application fee upon submission.
If you are eligible for an application fee waiver, complete the proper form (including any required approvals) from the choices below and upload it into the application when prompted.
You may be prompted to add a waiver code, in addition to the document upload.
United States Service Member
McNair Scholar (form located within the online application)
UNCW Faculty/Staff or Dependent
Recommendations
Close Accordion
Open Accordion
Recommendation Info
Recommendations
Required by some programs. View the key dates pages to see if your program requires recommendations.
Recommenders submit the recommendation through the online application.
During the application process, applicants will be prompted to enter the names and contact information of your recommender.
An e-mail notification will be sent on your behalf, prompting the recommender to complete the survey.
Your application may be submitted prior to recommender completion.
Self-monitor the progress from your online application portal.
Recommendation FAQ
My recommender has not received the e-mail with the login information. What do I do?
Notification e-mails will indicate "gradschool@uncw.edu" as the sender. If the recommender's e-mail uses a spam-blocking tool, ask that the recommender add gradschool@uncw.edu to their safe/known recipient list.
Type the recommender email address to avoid the addition of invisible characters by using copy/paste.
Ask for a personal email address (i.e., Gmail or Yahoo)
How do I change a recommender?
As long as the recommender has not already submitted the recommendation, you may log back into your online application and choose 'exclude' for current recommender, and add an alternate recommender.
May I reuse recommendations from a previous application?
Recommendations may be reused from a submitted application (with paid application fee) for up to one academic year.
My program only requires 2 recommendations. What happens if I list 3 recommenders?
Listing more than the required recommendations will delay the processing of your application.
I did not waive my right to review the recommendation. How may I view the recommendation that was submitted on my behalf?
Recommendations from a submitted application (with paid application fee) may be viewed by making an appointment. We are happy to meet with you virtually to review the recommendation(s) that were submitted on your behalf. Please note that state-issued photo identification is required to view recommendations.

Request Official Transcripts
General Instructions
Close Accordion
Open Accordion
Unofficial transcripts are uploaded within the online application during the admission process. The Graduate School requires one unofficial transcript from every college or university you’ve attended
Upon admission, one official transcript reflecting an awarded bachelor's degree will be required upon admission. The bachelor’s degree must be from a college or university accredited by an approved institutional accreditor.
Transcripts are not required for short term study abroad work that is transcripted (i.e., the courses and/or grades from the study abroad experience are listed).
List your full legal name and any and all past names on your application.
The Graduate School does not return or reissue documents submitted as part of the application, including transcripts.
After Admission - Final/Official Bachelor's Awarded Transcripts To:
Electronic Method:
Password protected transcripts requested directly from the institution.
You may choose UNCW Graduate School, UNC-Wilmington, etc. or they may be sent directly from the system by email to UNCW.
Paper Method - Official Transcript (Envelope Sealed by the Institution):
UNCW Graduate School
Attn: Kimberly Goerne Harris
601 S. College Rd.
Wilmington, NC 28403-5955
Ever Attended UNCW?
Close Accordion
Open Accordion
You do not need to request a UNCW transcript if you have ever attended UNCW
List UNCW as an institution on your application.
The Graduate School will be responsible for obtaining your academic record from mySeaport (at no cost to you*), including any transfer work reflected on your UNCW transcript.
Submit official transcripts from any institution not reflected on your UNCW transcript or any institution attended after UNCW.

Application Checklist
Close Accordion
Open Accordion
Once you have submitted your application, you can monitor the arrival of supplemental documents on your application checklist.
It is your responsibility to ensure that all application materials arrive, and to follow up with any recommenders or transcripts that are not checked off on your Application Checklist.
Complete applications are forwarded to programs for review.
To access your application checklist:
Log in to the application portal.
Select 'applications'.
Review the application checklist to confirm that all items have been received.
